# AMS Civil Construction — Complete Knowledge Base

> AMS Civil Construction is India's trusted civil contractor headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra. With over 25 years of expertise, we deliver premium construction services including bungalow construction, home renovation, bathroom & kitchen remodeling, tiling, flooring, POP ceilings, plaster work, waterproofing, swimming pool construction, and compound wall building. We serve 90+ cities across Maharashtra, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Karnataka, and Goa.

---

## About AMS Civil Construction

AMS Civil Construction was founded by **Kedar Mandal**, a veteran civil engineer with 25+ years of hands-on experience in residential and commercial construction. The company has grown from a local Mumbai contractor to a national-level civil construction firm with an impeccable track record of 500+ completed projects.

### Core Values
- **Zero Hidden Costs**: Every quotation is detailed and itemized
- **Quality First**: Only ISI-certified materials (UltraTech/ACC Cement, TATA Tiscon/JSW Steel, Kajaria/Somany Tiles, Finolex Pipes, Polycab Wires)
- **On-Time Delivery**: Milestone-based project tracking
- **Direct Communication**: Senior engineers supervise on-site — no middlemen

### Achievements
- 500+ projects completed
- 4.9/5 average rating from 140+ verified customer reviews
- 25+ years of continuous operation
- Serving 90+ cities across 5 states
- 1-year workmanship warranty on all projects

## Detailed Service Descriptions

### 1. Bungalow Construction
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/bungalow-construction

End-to-end luxury bungalow construction from foundation to finishing. We handle soil testing, structural engineering, RCC work, brickwork, plastering, tiling, painting, and all interior finishing. Our bungalows are designed to withstand Mumbai's heavy monsoon using corrosion-resistant steel and advanced concrete mixes.

**Process**:
1. Planning & Approvals — Soil testing, 3D design, municipal licensing
2. Foundation & RCC Frame — Excavation, deep foundations, concrete framing
3. Brickwork & Utilities — Masonry, concealed wiring, plumbing
4. Plastering & Finishes — Internal/external plaster, tiling, painting

**Materials**: UltraTech/ACC Cement, TATA Tiscon/JSW Steel, Kajaria/Somany Tiles, Finolex Pipes & Polycab Wires

**Pricing**: Calculated per square foot — basic, premium, and luxury specifications available. Free estimate provided.

### 2. Bathroom Renovation
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/bathroom-renovation

Complete bathroom transformation including demolition, waterproofing, new plumbing lines, premium tile installation, modern sanitary ware fitting, glass shower enclosures, and LED vanity mirrors. We use triple-layer waterproofing (Dr. Fixit / Sika systems) with 10-year leak-free guarantee.

**Process**:
1. Demolition & Planning — Old fixture removal, layout design
2. Plumbing & Waterproofing — New concealed plumbing, triple-layer waterproofing
3. Tile Installation — Premium wall & floor tiles with precision cutting
4. Fixture Installation — Sanitary ware, shower, vanity, accessories

### 3. Kitchen Work
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/kitchen-work

Premium modular kitchen construction including countertop installation (granite/quartz), cabinet frameworks, plumbing routing, electrical wiring for appliances, chimney ducting, and anti-skid flooring.

### 4. Full Interior Work
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/full-interior-work

Complete home interior civil work — wall demolition, partition construction, false ceiling framework, electrical rerouting, surface leveling, premium tiling, POP molding, wall putty, and luxury paint coats.

### 5. Tiles Work
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/tiles-work

Expert tile installation for walls and floors — vitrified tiles, ceramic tiles, porcelain tiles, mosaic tiles, natural stone tiles. Precision cutting, waterproof grouting, and anti-skid options available.

### 6. Flooring Work
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/flooring-work

Premium flooring installation — Italian marble, Kota stone, granite, vitrified tiles, wooden/laminate flooring. Includes sub-floor leveling, moisture barrier, and polishing.

### 7. POP Work
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/pop-work

Designer POP (Plaster of Paris) false ceilings — tray ceilings, cove lighting ceilings, decorative cornices, wall niches, and architectural moldings.

### 8. Plaster Work
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/plaster-work

Internal & external plastering — sand-faced cement plaster, gypsum plaster, POP plaster, wall putty application, and texture finishes.

### 9. Wall Work
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/wall-work

Brick masonry, AAC block walls, glass block partitions, retaining walls, and decorative stone cladding.

### 10. Painting
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/painting

Interior & exterior painting — texture paint, emulsion, enamel, waterproof exterior coats, designer accent walls. Brands: Asian Paints, Berger, Nerolac.

### 11. Waterproofing
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/waterproofing

Terrace, bathroom, basement, and tank waterproofing using Dr. Fixit, Sika, and Fosroc systems. Crystalline coating, membrane application, and injection grouting.

### 12. Swimming Pool Work
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/swimming-pool-work

Private swimming pool construction — excavation, double-mesh RCC structure, triple-layer waterproofing, glass mosaic tiles, automated filtration, and LED lighting.

### 13. Compound Wall Work
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/compound-wall-work

Boundary wall construction — deep RCC footings, concrete columns, heavy-duty brick masonry, decorative finishes, and custom gate installation.

### 14. Building Repair Work
**URL**: https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/building-repair-work

Structural repair, crack injection, concrete restoration, spalling repair, carbon fiber strengthening, and external rehabilitation.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### General
**Q: What areas does AMS Civil Construction serve?**
A: We serve 90+ locations across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane, Pune, Nagpur, Nasik, Aurangabad (Maharashtra), Ranchi, Jamshedpur, Dhanbad (Jharkhand), Kolkata, Asansol, Siliguri (West Bengal), Bangalore, Mysore (Karnataka), and Panjim, Margao (Goa).

**Q: How much does construction cost per square foot in Mumbai?**
A: Construction costs in Mumbai typically range from ₹1,800-₹3,500 per sq ft for basic work, ₹3,500-₹5,500 for premium, and ₹5,500+ for luxury specifications. Exact pricing depends on location, materials, and design complexity. We provide free, itemized estimates.

**Q: Does AMS Civil provide a warranty?**
A: Yes, we provide a 1-year workmanship warranty on all projects. Structural work comes with extended warranty coverage.

**Q: What materials does AMS Civil use?**
A: We exclusively use ISI-certified materials — UltraTech/ACC Cement, TATA Tiscon/JSW Steel, Kajaria/Somany Tiles, Finolex Pipes, Polycab/Havells Wires, Dr. Fixit/Sika Waterproofing.

**Q: How do payments work?**
A: We follow a milestone-based payment system. You pay only as you see progress — foundation complete, structure complete, finishing complete. No advance payment required beyond initial booking.

**Q: Can I get a free consultation?**
A: Yes! We offer completely free site visits and consultations. Call +91 8779391690 or visit https://www.amscivilwork.in/free-consultation to book.

### Service-Specific
**Q: How long does a bathroom renovation take?**
A: A standard bathroom renovation takes 15-25 days depending on size and complexity. We handle everything from demolition to waterproofing to final fixtures.

**Q: What is the cost of bungalow construction in Mumbai?**
A: Bungalow construction costs ₹2,200-₹5,500+ per sq ft depending on specifications. A 2000 sq ft bungalow typically costs ₹45L-₹1.1Cr. Contact us for a precise estimate based on your plot and requirements.

**Q: Do you build swimming pools?**
A: Yes! We specialize in private residential swimming pools with complete engineering — excavation, RCC structure, triple-layer waterproofing, glass mosaic tiles, and automated filtration systems.
